scope: Prospectively fixed exploratory extension on the historical filtered cohort. Twelve runs; all seeds reported. No pHash curation changes. Preprocessing follows the pinned TensorFlow example; local weight hashes identify supplied artifacts, not independent publisher authentication. Validation is fixed and not augmented, unlike historical scripts. This is not an exact rerun of their training or a BatchNorm-only ablation. The historical test set has already informed prior research and is not a new external confirmation cohort.
